name: Eclipse
source:
The world ended. Alt, still alive somehow, makes their way through an abandoned city and faces a choice.

[From [url=https://limulidae.itch.io/eclipse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界終結了。阿爾特不知怎麼活了下來，穿過一座廢棄的城市，走到了必須做出選擇的關頭。
